product_metadata.title: Lasko 4000L 4000 Air Stik Ultra-Slim Oscillating Table Fan for Indoor, Bedroom, Home Office and More, Gray, 14 inches
features: Takes up very little surface space--great for on a desk; 14" tall.
Patented fused safety plug, ETL listed for safety
description: The Lasko Air Stik® oscillating fan features 2 quiet, refreshing speeds. Its ultra-slim design makes it a great addition to the office or anywhere space is at a premium. Quite powerful for its size, this small tower fan has a stylish look that blends well with other decor. This tabletop fan's electronic controls have a beautiful blue LED light illuminating its power and oscillation buttons. Includes Lasko's trusted, fused safety plug and complies with ETL certifications and standards. Comes fully assembled. 1-year limited warranty.

details.Special Feature: 2 quiet speeds, widespread oscillation, perfect desktop size
details.Included Components: User Manual, Fused Safety Plug, Lasko 4000 Air Stik Ultra-Slim Oscillating Fan
